_doc: Hand corrections from the reviews of 2026-11-28, applied by collect.py to printed labels before anything else. merge: two gazetteer ids for one place (the glossary shows one entry; the finder's gazetteer is not changed). drop: a label attached by the finder to the wrong place, with no right place in the gazetteer (it is left out and logged in suspects.tsv). move: a label attached to the wrong place, moved to the right one.
